description: This file defines the Displace class which manages shader keywords for water vertex displacement effects in a Unity environment. It toggles shader keywords to enable or disable water vertex displacement when the component is enabled or disabled.

classes.name: Displace
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that controls shader keywords to toggle water vertex displacement effects.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Initializes the component by calling OnEnable or OnDisable based on whether the component is enabled.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Enables the shader keyword for water vertex displacement and disables the off version.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Disables the shader keyword for water vertex displacement and enables the off version.
